item.title: Heads up: Natural avalanches ‘likely this afternoon’
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Fluctuating winter weather has led to heightened avalanche danger today, according to the Tuesday morning forecast by the Bridger-Teton Avalanche Center (BTAC). BTAC advises that avalanche danger is considered high above 9,000 feet, and considerable above 7,500 feet.
